text:
ashley: Heads-up — PR #8234 (runtime/kv-warmup hotfix) is ready for merge but we need two signoffs before the 18:40 UTC cutoff. CI is mostly green but one flaky e2e keeps failing intermittently. Can night-owl approvers ping in? :alarm_clock:

maya: on it, pinging now. which test is flaking? I can run locally.

ashley: the failing test is tests/e2e/test-kv_warmup.py::test_warmup. failure is a timing assertion in CI logs. example run: `AssertionError: expected warmup to finish in < 3s` — local run passes for me once.

jim: I can reproduce locally when I run the full suite. quick repro command I used:
```
pytest tests/e2e/test-kv_warmup.py::test_warmup -q --maxfail=1
```
I can try adding a small sleep to the harness to see if it's just a race.

tariq: I have one LH to give but cannot be online at cutoff. If someone else gives the second signoff I can add an approving comment before I step out. Is there a canary / backstop plan if the hotfix causes regressions?

ashley: plan: if merged before cutoff we run a 10% canary for 15 minutes, metrics to watch: token latency p50/p95 on /generate, error rate, and kv-warmup total CPU. Rollback plan: revert commit and roll forward with previous artifact; deploy-bot will trigger rollback if error rate > 1% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule created — canary window target 18:50 UTC for 15m if merge occurs <= 18:40 UTC. Auto-rollback threshold configured.

maya: I can give LGTM, but want CI green on that test once more. I'll rerun that job and post the result.

jim: re-ran locally with `-k kv_warmup -vv` a couple times, still flaky ~1/6 runs. I added a 200ms buffer in the harness and it becomes stable, but I don't want to land a test change in the hotfix.

ashley: agree — don't change tests in hotfix. alternative: add a transient retry in the test runner for that job only, controlled via env var. If CI passes on rerun we can take the LGTM.

maya: CI rerun passed on job #4721. I'm dropping my LGTM now. :white_check_mark:

tariq: second LGTM from me, leaving an approving comment. go ahead and merge if deploy-bot confirms canary scheduled.

ashley: merging now. tagging rollback owner @jim. thanks all — will monitor dashboards and call rollback if any red flags. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Merge recorded: PR #8234 merged into main at 1768001805. Canary started at 18:50 UTC.

jim: watching metrics, p95 looks nominal, no error surge. good to greenlight full rollout after 15m if stable.

ashley: moving to full rollout in 10. thanks for swift eyes everyone.

maya: nice teamwork. night-owl crew, enjoy the rest of your shifts. :coffee:
